name: session-meter
description: Gauges above the prompt: prompt-cache age on a green-to-red dial with a needle, context window fill, the plan's session and weekly usage, and the session's cost. Sends nothing anywhere.

warnMinutes.title: Cache age turning yellow (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: From this cache age on, the cache dial and its figure are yellow.

staleMinutes.title: Cache age turning red (minutes)
staleMinutes.description: Past this cache age, the cache dial and its figure are red.

gaugeMinutes.title: Cache gauge full scale (minutes)
gaugeMinutes.description: The cache age at the dial's right end; the needle stops there.
